widget.name: Ticket Status Chart
widget.description: Counts tickets per lane (status) per period from a list of status changes and shows the result as stacked bars, a stacked area or lines. No helper entities or microflows needed.

property.caption: Status changes
property.description: The list of status-change records, one object per change (for example AuditLogging.LogLine). Tip: add an XPath constraint so only lane changes come in, e.g. [Member = 'MyModule.Ticket_Lane'], and limit the time span (e.g. last year) for large logs. All matching objects are loaded.

property.caption: Change date
property.description: When the change happened. Can be reached over an association, e.g. LogLine_Log/Log/DateTime. Each change is placed in the period that contains this date.

property.caption: New lane
property.description: The lane (status) the ticket moved INTO with this change, e.g. LogLine/NewValue. It may contain the lane name, or the lane's object id (as AuditLogging stores for associations): fill in "Lanes" below and ids are turned into names automatically.

property.caption: Ticket ID
property.description: Something unique per ticket, so the widget knows which changes belong to the same ticket, e.g. LogLine_Log/Log/Log_Ticket/Ticket/TicketNumber. Required for "Lane snapshot" mode; not used by "Moves per period".

property.caption: Lanes
property.description: Optional list of all lanes (e.g. the Lane entity, sorted the way you want them stacked). Used to: turn lane ids from "New lane" into names, set the order of lanes in the chart and legend (first = bottom of the stack), and show lanes that currently have 0 tickets.

property.caption: Lane name
property.description: The display name of a lane, e.g. Lane/Name. Should match the text in "New lane" when that holds names.

property.caption: Lane color
property.description: Optional color per lane stored on the lane object, as a CSS color (e.g. #E74C3C). Wins over "Lane colors" on the Lanes tab.

property.caption: What to count
property.description: Lane snapshot: how many tickets were in each lane at the END of each period (each ticket counted once, in the lane of its latest change). Moves per period: how many changes INTO each lane happened during each period.

enumerationValues.enumerationValue: Lane snapshot (tickets per lane at period end)
Moves per period (changes into each lane)

property.caption: Period
property.description: The size of one bar / point on the time axis.

property.caption: Periods to show
property.description: How many periods to show, counting back from the last period. Example: Period = Month and 12 = the last 12 months. Use 0 to show everything from the first change on.

property.caption: Last period
property.description: Today: the chart ends with the current period (also when nothing changed recently). Last change: the chart ends with the period of the newest change in the data.

property.caption: Week starts on
property.description: Only used when Period = Week.

property.caption: Chart style
property.description: Stacked bars: one bar per period, split by lane (best for comparing totals). Stacked area: the same as a filled area over time. Lines: one line per lane (best for comparing lanes with each other).

property.caption: Title
property.description: Optional title shown above the chart, e.g. "Tickets per lane".

property.caption: Height (px)
property.description: Height of the chart area in pixels. The width always follows the container.

property.caption: Show totals
property.description: Stacked styles: writes the total number on top of each period. Lines: adds a dashed "Total" line.

property.caption: Show grid lines
property.description: Light horizontal lines behind the chart to help reading values.

property.caption: Lane colors
property.description: Optional fixed colors per lane name, separated by ";". Example: Open=#E74C3C; In progress=#F39C12; Done=#27AE60. Lanes without a color get one from the default palette, always the same for the same lane order.

property.caption: Hide lanes
property.description: Lane names to leave out, separated by ";". Example: Done; Cancelled (useful in snapshot mode, where finished tickets keep growing). Use (empty) for changes without a lane.

property.caption: Lane order
property.description: Optional stacking order when no "Lanes" list is set, separated by ";". First = bottom of the stack. Example: Open; In progress; Review; Done. Lanes not listed come after, alphabetically.

property.caption: X axis title
property.description: Optional text under the time axis, e.g. "Month".

property.caption: Y axis title
property.description: Optional text next to the count axis, e.g. "Tickets".

property.caption: Date label format
property.description: Optional format of the period labels. Leave empty for automatic (Day: 05 Mar, Week: W10 2026, Month: Mar 2026, Quarter: Q1 2026, Year: 2026). Tokens: d, dd, MMM, MMMM, MM, yy, yyyy, W (week number), Q (quarter). Text in quotes is kept, e.g. 'Week' W.

property.caption: Show legend
property.description: Shows which color belongs to which lane. Click a lane in the legend to hide or show it.

property.caption: Legend position
property.description: Where the legend is placed around the chart.
